unsupported_jni: all other methods; no JVM, Java classes or worker attachment
graphics: original RGBA framebuffer uploaded through system SDL2/GLES2
audio: original mono S16 PCM, queued on main thread, 48000 Hz
input: keyboard arrows or SDL gamepad D-pad/left stick; Escape, Back or Start saves and exits
scope: teaching adapter; not a universal Android compatibility layer
